newsitem.title: USA: GalaGen seeks patients for Sporidin-G test.
newsitem.headline: GalaGen seeks patients for Sporidin-G test.

text.p: GalaGen Inc said Tuesday it is continuing to seek patients for clinical trials of its Sporidin-G, being developed to fight the Cryptosporidium parvum infection common in AIDS patients.
GalaGen said it has expanded the number of clinical sites in order to enrolll the required number of patients who meet the trial criteria.

"If the trial demonstrates efficacy, GalaGen believes the data may support the filing of a product licensing application with the FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)," GalaGen said in a statement.
Earlier, GalaGen reported a third quarter loss of $0.27 a share versus a loss of $0.20 last year, including a gain on the extinguishment of debt.
